review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this planning-only C scenario. Only the selected branch is required. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, DEC-001, and both task keys are preserved. Construction-time overlap rejection can therefore remain within the exact writable implementation and two regression-test paths; forwarding and declaration consumers appropriately remain inspection owners. Build configuration supports treating emitted declarations as generated, not separately maintained owners. Runtime and TypeScript verification are distinguished by the supplied configurations. The implementer and distinct verifier have matching delivery roles, available slots, auto-assignment eligibility, and relevant active project-scoped trusted capability claims; pending legacy claims and personas are not needed to establish eligibility. The configured verifier may also satisfy independent read-only scenario review under the supplied policy, subject to independence from eventual planning authors. Repository, source, team, decision, prompt/build, model, sampling, budget, and metric-policy fingerprints are consistently bound in the supplied release inputs; the provenance explains the distinct source digest domains and PRD whitespace normalization. Earlier specification preparation placeholders do not override the subsequently supplied frozen release inputs. Approval concerns expected planning readiness, not execution readiness or authorization to dispatch. A material unresolved DEC-001 in paired B must still block at decisions; C's hypothetical choice cannot resolve B. No candidate outputs were used, no human attestation was created, and no code was executed or digest independently recomputed.
